body_long:
The Ritz Paris is opening its peristyle to a new generation of photographers. From Friday 13 to Monday 16 November 2026, the hotel at 15 place Vendôme hosts a free exhibition of work by 18 students from the photo and video department of GOBELINS Paris. The show was listed by Sortiraparis on 10 November 2026.

## Carte blanche at Place Vendôme

The hotel gave the students a free hand, with one subject: the Ritz itself. Their images look at the architecture and the interiors, at the atmosphere of the house, and at what guests rarely see: the spaces behind the scenes and the teams at work. The result is 18 works, one per student, shown in the peristyle and open to everyone.

The names of the photographers, the opening hours and the curator have not been published in the sources we have read. Visitors are advised to check with the hotel before coming.

## A Paris Photo week

The dates are no coincidence. Paris Photo, the city's international photography fair, runs at the Grand Palais from 12 to 15 November 2026, from 1pm to 8pm (7pm on Sunday). The exhibition at the Ritz opens the day after the fair and closes the day after it ends, giving visitors one more stop on the Right Bank. The Ritz is not among the fair's 18 official hotel partners, which include Le Meurice, Shangri-La Paris, Mandarin Oriental Paris and Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme: it has built its own programme instead.

## A house with a photographic memory

Photography has long been part of the Ritz story. Man Ray photographed there in 1922, and Brassaï, Robert Doisneau and Richard Avedon are among the photographers linked to its history. Inviting students in continues that line, with a younger and less formal eye.

The hotel is led by General Manager Arnaud de Saint-Exupéry, whose appointment was announced in September 2025. He came from Hyatt, where he led the UK and Ireland portfolio and had opened the Park Hyatt Paris-Vendôme in 2002.

## The signal

A palace that lets students photograph its staff and its back-of-house is a palace confident in its craft. During a fair week, a free show in the peristyle gives Parisians and visitors a reason to walk through the door without booking a room or a table. For a house built on discretion, it is a measured way to stay part of the city's cultural conversation, and to show that the people behind the service are part of the legend too.
summary: From 13 to 16 November 2026, the Ritz Paris hosts a free exhibition in its peristyle by 18 students from GOBELINS Paris, who photographed the hotel's architecture, interiors, back-of-house and teams, during Paris Photo week.
title: The Ritz Paris gives carte blanche to 18 GOBELINS photographers for Paris Photo week
